notes: This is the latest-per-test union of separate runs, not one monolithic run of all tests on one source revision.
The preparation rejection case was renamed to its intended readiness replacement and is counted once; old failures remain in history.

Historical product hashes were not captured. Report hashes authenticate the evidence bytes; current source hashes describe the final source snapshot only and are not assigned retroactively to earlier runs.
Final layout/workspace/readiness/native-complex and structural-analysis checks were rerun on index-YBadVVti.js; early cancellation cases were rerun after the supervisor fix.
Native recovery continuity is a software check on short trajectories, not proof of equilibration, convergence or bitwise reproducibility.

runs.command: npx playwright test workspace-library.spec.ts ui-audit-controls.spec.ts fullscreen-header.spec.ts live-measurements.spec.ts pinch-zoom.spec.ts --output=../data/integration-checks/workspace-ui-artifacts --reporter=list,json

npx playwright test e2e.spec.ts ui-audit-imports.spec.ts ui-audit-jobs.spec.ts ui-audit-recovery.spec.ts ui-audit-sources.spec.ts preparation-jobs.spec.ts preparation-progress.spec.ts preparation.e2e.spec.ts hydrogen-context.spec.ts modified-residue-inspection.spec.ts --output=../data/integration-checks/workspace-legacy-artifacts --reporter=list,json

npx playwright test workspace-library.spec.ts fullscreen-header.spec.ts preparation-progress.spec.ts preparation.e2e.spec.ts ui-audit-sources.spec.ts --grep 'workspace|fullscreen|Projects|preparation readiness|Studio PDB upload|validated complex' --output=../data/integration-checks/workspace-release-artifacts --reporter=list,json
npx playwright test ui-audit-jobs.spec.ts --grep 'running OpenMM monitor|prepared PDB download' --output=../data/integration-checks/workspace-cancellation-artifacts --reporter=list,json

Cancelled job Files downloads a nonempty ZIP
Resume button launches continuation of the same job
Completion retains Files and opens the result trajectory
Simulation readiness suspends while a job is active
Readiness rechecks after completion and Start simulation becomes enabled again
